CrunchbaseAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste your provisioned Crunchbase REST API key. REST API access is licensed separately from an MCP seat. NoClick sends it in X-cb-user-key to api.crunchbase.com. Access to collections and fields depends on your package; connecting checks an organization lookup, not account identity or all collection permissions.
